payload.title: Initial finite latent common-cause fits
payload.factorization: P(a,b,lambda)=sum_omega P(omega)P(a|omega)P(b|omega)P(lambda|omega), with 16 deterministic local response strategies.
payload.interpretation: Approximate finite statistical common-cause realizations were found. These fitted costs are feasible realization costs, not global minima. Only three restarts were used.
payload.open_physics_requirements: Identify physical Omega, dynamics, spacetime consistency, source/setting-device couplings and independent testable predictions.
